generation.explanation: The tangent function y = tan(x) equals sin(x)/cos(x), so it is undefined wherever cos(x) = 0. Those points are vertical asymptotes: x = π/2 + kπ (odd multiples of π/2). On (−2π, 2π) they sit at −3π/2, −π/2, π/2, and 3π/2. Between consecutive asymptotes tan(x) is continuous and strictly increases from −∞ to +∞, and the whole pattern repeats every π.
